thinkInterval.note: Each unit reconsiders its orders this often (0.5 s x7, rounded up).

squareProximity.note: Infantry forms square if unblown enemy cavalry is this close, whatever it is doing (100 px x1.4).

squareHoldProximity.note: A square stays in square while cavalry is this close (200 px x1.4).

squareSafetyMargin.note: Infantry targeted by cavalry forms square when the cavalry could arrive within its time to form square plus this margin. Replaces the prototype's fixed 185 px, which assumed its 3.5 s formation change.

cavApproachSpeed.note: Speed assumed for that estimate: between trot and gallop.

threatQualityBonus.note: Steadier troops react earlier: added distance x (1 - steadiness) (90 px x1.4).

deployRange.note: Attack in line: stay in column beyond this distance from the target, deploy inside it (210 px x1.4).

engageRange.note: Attack in line: halt and fire at this distance (80 px x1.4).

chargeMoraleAbsolute.note: Attack in line: close with the bayonet when the target's morale is below this.

chargeMoraleAdvantage.note: Or when it is this far below the attacker's own.

faceTolerance.note: Halted infantry re-faces only if the nearest enemy is more than this off its front (0.45 rad).

moveFaceToleranceInfantry.note: A unit must be pointed within this angle of its heading before it steps off (0.4 rad).

separationFactor.note: Friends closer than this fraction of their combined radii push apart.

cavLeashDefend.note: Defending cavalry ignores targets farther than this (330 px x1.4).

cavMinScore.note: A target must score above this to be charged.

cavScoreRouted.note: Base score of a routed unit within cavRoutChaseRange.

cavGunsSupportedPenalty.note: Subtracted if formed infantry stands within cavGunsSupportRadius of the battery.

cavScoreShakenSquare.note: A steady square is never charged.

cavScoreForming.note: Infantry that will still be changing formation when the charge arrives.

cavScoreFlank.note: Infantry approachable from flank or rear.

cavScoreUnderFire.note: Infantry hit within the last cavUnderFireWindow.

cavDistanceCostNear.note: Distance penalty for guns, cavalry and defending cavalry's infantry targets (9 px x1.4).

cavDistanceCostFar.note: For squares and for attacking cavalry's infantry targets (12 px x1.4).

cavFormingMargin.note: Cavalry counts infantry as catchable if its remaining formation time exceeds the ride time plus this (0.3 s x7).

cavFollowDistance.note: Attacking cavalry with no target keeps this far behind its leading infantry (130 px x1.4).

cavStandoff.note: With no infantry left it closes to this distance from the nearest enemy (260 px x1.4).

cavHomeTolerance.note: Defending cavalry returns to its post if farther from it than this (40 px x1.4).

artAdvanceFraction.note: An attacking battery advances until the nearest enemy is this close (390 of 430 px).

artDistanceScale.note: Target score is divided by 1 + distance / (this x effective range) (260 of 430 px).

artPreferredBonus.note: A target the player has pointed the battery at.

redeployFactor.note: Attack in line: a battalion already in line returns to column only if its target is farther than deployRange times this. Not in the prototype, where changing formation took 3.5 s and switching back and forth cost nothing; at real drill times it left battalions re-forming under canister.
